title: CNF width after restricting a clause
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction. The clause obtained by restricting the clause represented by $T$ has a conjunctive normal form representation of width at most the restricted width of $T$, computed using the restriction with its fixed signs negated.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate restriction on the $n$ coordinates
